The '''Geonosis Arena Acklay-Rider''' was a ride that was located in [[Aucellis Park]], an entertainment park that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Keriba VI]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030821aucellis|text=Beneath Aucellis Park|int=Beneath Aucellis Park}}</ref>
